';
  var SANS_BOLD = '';

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- capture (PDF button flows)
  async function capturePrintFrame(frame, filename, destination){
    if(PDF_BUSY) return;
    PDF_BUSY = true; pdfToast('جاري إنشاء ملف PDF حقيقي…');
    try{
      var blob = await buildPdfFromSnapshot(frameSnapshot(frame), filename);
      var saved = await pdfStoreBlob(blob, filename || pdfSafeName('طباعة'), destination);
      if(saved === 'saved') pdfToast('تم حفظ ملف PDF بنجاح.');
      else if(saved === false) pdfToast('تم إلغاء حفظ الملف.');
      else pdfToast('');
    }catch(err){
      console.error('Direct PDF export failed', err);
      pdfToast('تعذر إنشاء ملف PDF' + (err && err.message ? ': ' + err.message : '') + '. حاول مرة أخرى.', true);
    }finally{ PDF_BUSY = false; }
  }
  async function downloadPdfFromPrintFrame(frame, filename, destination){
    if(!frame || !frame.contentDocument) throw new Error('نافذة الطباعة غير جاهزة');
    var blob = await buildPdfFromSnapshot(frameSnapshot(frame), filename);
    return await pdfStoreBlob(blob, filename || pdfSafeName('طباعة'), destination);
  }
  async function pdfFromSnapshotWithSave(snap, filename){
    if(PDF_BUSY) return;
    var destination = await pdfPrepareDestination(filename);
    if(destination === false) return;
    PDF_BUSY = true; pdfToast('جاري إنشاء ملف PDF حقيقي…');
    try{
      var blob = await buildPdfFromSnapshot(snap, filename);
      var saved = await pdfStoreBlob(blob, filename, destination);
      if(saved === 'saved') pdfToast('تم حفظ ملف PDF بنجاح.'); else pdfToast('');
    }catch(err){
      console.error(err); pdfToast('تعذر إنشاء ملف PDF' + (err && err.message ? ': ' + err.message : ''), true);
    }finally{ PDF_BUSY = false; }
  }

  /* nb-v1.37: تطبيق الأستاذ يحتاج PDF حقيقياً من إطار الطباعة (لا طابعة مباشرة في تطبيقه) — إضافة فقط */
  window.__nbPdfFromFrame = function(frame, filename){ return buildPdfFromSnapshot(frameSnapshot(frame), filename); };
  function requestPdfForPrintAction(action, filename, destination){
    if(PDF_BUSY) return;
    PDF_REQUEST = {filename: filename || pdfSafeName('طباعة'), destination: destination || null, started: Date.now()};
    try{ action(); }
    catch(e){ PDF_REQUEST = null; pdfToast('تعذر تجهيز ملف PDF.', true); }
    setTimeout(function(){
      if(PDF_REQUEST && Date.now() - PDF_REQUEST.started > 6000){ PDF_REQUEST = null; pdfToast('لم تكتمل بيانات الطباعة. افتح الصفحة المطلوبة ثم حاول مجدداً.', true); }
    }, 6500);
  }
  // a stale PDF request must never hijack a later, unrelated print click
  document.addEventListener('click', function(){
    if(PDF_REQUEST && Date.now() - PDF_REQUEST.started > 1800) PDF_REQUEST = null;
  }, true);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- smart printing
  function pageInfoFor(frame, snap){
    var info = {title: snap.title || 'Daragat', widthMm: snap.widthPx * MM, heightMm: snap.heightPx * MM, marginsMm: [0, 0, 0, 0]};
    try{
      var rules = readPageRules(frame.contentDocument), sz = parsePageSize(rules.size);
      if(sz){ info.widthMm = sz[0]; info.heightMm = sz[1]; }
      info.marginsMm = parsePageMargin(rules.margin);
    }catch(e){}
    info.landscape = info.widthMm > info.heightMm;
    return info;
  }
  function attemptFramePrint(frame){
    return new Promise(function(resolve){
      var pw = frame.contentWindow, fired = false;
      function mark(){ fired = true; }
      try{ pw.addEventListener('beforeprint', mark); pw.addEventListener('afterprint', mark); }catch(e){}
      try{ window.addEventListener('beforeprint', mark); window.addEventListener('afterprint', mark); }catch(e){}
      function done(){
        try{ pw.removeEventListener('beforeprint', mark); pw.removeEventListener('afterprint', mark); }catch(e){}
        try{ window.removeEventListener('beforeprint', mark); window.removeEventListener('afterprint', mark); }catch(e){}
        resolve(fired);
      }
      try{ if(pw.focus) pw.focus(); pw.print(); }
      catch(e){ done(); return; }
      setTimeout(done, 1000);
    });
  }
  function openPrintWindow(snap){
    try{
      var w = window.open('', '_blank');
      if(!w){ pdfToast('منع المتصفح فتح نافذة جديدة للطباعة.', true); return; }
      w.document.open(); w.document.write(snap.html); w.document.close();
      setTimeout(function(){ try{ w.focus(); w.print(); }catch(e){} }, 800);
    }catch(e){ pdfToast('تعذر فتح صفحة الطباعة.', true); }
  }
  function showPrintFallback(snap, name){
    var body =
      '<p style="margin:0 0 12px;color:#455a64;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.9">لم تظهر نافذة الطباعة على هذا الجهاز. يمكنك حفظ الصفحة كملف PDF ثم طباعتها من تطبيق الملفات أو من حاسوب/طابعة تدعم PDF.</p>' +
      '<div style="display:grid;gap:8px">' +
      '<button type="button" id="dpFbPdf" style="' + BTN + ';background:#2e7d32">📄 حفظ كملف PDF</button>' +
      (IS_WEBVIEW ? '' : '<button type="button" id="dpFbWin" style="' + BTN + ';background:#1565c0">🖨️ فتح صفحة الطباعة في نافذة جديدة</button>') +
      '<button type="button" id="dpFbClose" style="padding:10px;border:1px solid #cfd8dc;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:#546e7a;font-weight:800;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer">إغلاق</button></div>';
    var m = openModal('daragatPrintFallback', 'الطباعة', body);
    m.querySelector('[data-x="close"]').onclick = function(){ closeModal('daragatPrintFallback'); };
    m.querySelector('#dpFbClose').onclick = function(){ closeModal('daragatPrintFallback'); };
    m.querySelector('#dpFbPdf').onclick = function(){ closeModal('daragatPrintFallback'); pdfFromSnapshotWithSave(snap, pdfSafeName(name || 'طباعة')); };
    var w = m.querySelector('#dpFbWin'); if(w) w.onclick = function(){ closeModal('daragatPrintFallback'); openPrintWindow(snap); };
  }
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- printing through the app's own PDF engine
  // The app fixes the page geometry (paper size, margins, one sheet per page) inside a finished PDF,
  // so the browser / Android print service only prints a file and cannot re-paginate or rescale it.
  // The old browser-print route stays available from the dialog ("الطريقة القديمة") and as an automatic
  // fallback if the PDF engine is unavailable. Set localStorage daragat_print_mode = 'browser' to make
  // the old route the default.
  var PRINT_MODE_KEY = 'daragat_print_mode';
  function printModeIsBrowser(){ try{ return localStorage.getItem(PRINT_MODE_KEY) === 'browser'; }catch(e){ return false; } }
  function showReadyPdfPrintModal(blob, name){
    return new Promise(function(resolve){
      var urls = [], settled = false;
      function done(v){
        if(settled) return; settled = true;
        closeModal('daragatReadyPrint');
        setTimeout(function(){ urls.forEach(function(u){ try{ URL.revokeObjectURL(u); }catch(e){} }); }, 180000);
        resolve(v);
      }
      var body =
        '<p style="margin:0 0 12px;color:#455a64;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.9">تم تجهيز الورقة بقياسها الحقيقي داخل ملف PDF جاهز، فلا يعيد المتصفح تقسيمها ولا تصغيرها عند الطباعة.</p>' +
        '<div style="display:grid;gap:8px">' +
        '<button type="button" id="drpPrint" style="' + BTN + ';background:#7a0e2e">🖨️ طباعة الملف الجاهز</button>' +
        '<button type="button" id="drpSave" style="' + BTN + ';background:#2e7d32">📄 حفظ كملف PDF</button>' +
        '<button type="button" id="drpLegacy" style="' + BTN + ';background:#546e7a">🌐 طباعة عبر المتصفح (الطريقة القديمة)</button>' +
        '<button type="button" id="drpClose" style="padding:10px;border:1px solid #cfd8dc;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:#546e7a;font-weight:800;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer">إغلاق</button></div>' +
        '<div id="drpStatus" style="display:none;margin-top:12px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.8"></div>';
      var m = openModal('daragatReadyPrint', 'الطباعة', body);
      var statusEl = m.querySelector('#drpStatus');
      function status(msg, kind){
        statusEl.style.display = 'block';
        statusEl.style.background = kind === 'err' ? '#ffebee' : (kind === 'ok' ? '#e8f5e9' : '#e3f2fd');
        statusEl.style.color = kind === 'err' ? '#b71c1c' : (kind === 'ok' ? '#1b5e20' : '#0d47a1');
        statusEl.textContent = msg;
      }
      m.querySelector('[data-x="close"]').onclick = function(){ done('closed'); };
      m.querySelector('#drpClose').onclick = function(){ done('closed'); };
      m.addEventListener('click', function(e){ if(e.target === m) done('closed'); });
      m.querySelector('#drpLegacy').onclick = function(){ done('legacy'); };
      m.querySelector('#drpSave').onclick = function(){
        closeModal('daragatReadyPrint');
        pdfStoreBlob(blob, name, null).then(function(r){
          if(r === 'saved') pdfToast('تم حفظ ملف PDF بنجاح.');
          settled = true; resolve('saved');
        }).catch(function(err){
          console.error(err); pdfToast('تعذر حفظ الملف' + (err && err.message ? ': ' + err.message : ''), true);
          settled = true; resolve('closed');
        });
      };
      m.querySelector('#drpPrint').onclick = function(){
        var u = '';
        try{ u = URL.createObjectURL(blob); urls.push(u); }catch(e){ status('تعذر تجهيز الملف للفتح. استخدم «حفظ كملف PDF».', 'err'); return; }
        var w = null;
        try{ w = window.open(u, '_blank'); }catch(e){ w = null; }
        if(w){ status('تم فتح الملف الجاهز. اطبعه من عارض PDF (زر الطباعة أو Ctrl+P) دون تغيير أي إعداد للقياس.', 'ok'); return; }
        try{
          var a = document.createElement('a');
          a.href = u; a.download = pdfEnsureExtension(name); a.rel = 'noopener'; a.style.display = 'none';
          document.body.appendChild(a); a.click();
          setTimeout(function(){ try{ a.remove(); }catch(e){} }, 2000);
          status('منع المتصفح فتح نافذة جديدة، فتم تنزيل الملف. افتحه من «التنزيلات» ثم اطبعه من عارض PDF.', 'info');
        }catch(e){ status('تعذر فتح الملف. استخدم «حفظ كملف PDF».', 'err'); }
      };
    });
  }
  async function printViaAppPdf(snap){
    // returns 'legacy' when the caller should fall back to browser printing
    if(IS_WEBVIEW) return 'legacy';            // embedded web views cannot open/print a PDF file; keep their existing handling
    if(PDF_BUSY){ pdfToast('جاري تجهيز ملف آخر، انتظر لحظة ثم أعد المحاولة.', true); return 'busy'; }
    var blob = null, name = pdfSafeName(snap.title || 'طباعة');
    PDF_BUSY = true;
    try{
      pdfToast('جاري تجهيز الملف للطباعة…');
      blob = await buildPdfFromSnapshot(snap, name);
    }catch(err){
      console.warn('App PDF print failed; falling back to browser printing', err);
      pdfToast('');
      return 'legacy';
    }finally{ PDF_BUSY = false; }
    pdfToast('');
    return await showReadyPdfPrintModal(blob, name);
  }
  async function smartPrintFrame(frame){
    var snap = null;
    try{ snap = frameSnapshot(frame); }catch(e){}
    var info = snap ? pageInfoFor(frame, snap) : null;
    // 1) native app printing (Android / Desktop wrappers)
    if(snap && nativeHas('printHtml')){
      try{
        var o1 = nativeOutcome(await nativeInvoke('printHtml', snap.html, JSON.stringify(info)));
        if(o1 === 'ok' || o1 === 'cancel') return;
      }catch(e){ console.warn('DaragatNative.printHtml failed', e); }
    }
    if(snap && nativeHas('printPdf')){
      try{
        pdfToast('جاري تجهيز الملف للطباعة…');
        var blob = await buildPdfFromSnapshot(snap, 'Daragat-print.pdf');
        var o2 = nativeOutcome(await nativeInvoke('printPdf', await blobToBase64(blob), pdfSafeName(snap.title || 'طباعة')));
        pdfToast('');
        if(o2 === 'ok' || o2 === 'cancel') return;
      }catch(e){ console.warn('DaragatNative.printPdf failed', e); pdfToast(''); }
    }
    // 2) default: the app builds the finished PDF itself and hands it over ready
    if(snap && !printModeIsBrowser()){
      var viaPdf = await printViaAppPdf(snap);
      if(viaPdf !== 'legacy') return;
    }
    // 3) browser printing with detection of "nothing happened"
    var fired = await attemptFramePrint(frame);
    if(!fired && snap) showPrintFallback(snap, snap.title);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- print frames for the results cards / exam cards
  function createCardsPrintFrame(){
    var pages = document.getElementById('pages');
    if(!pages){ pdfToast('افتح نموذج النتائج أولاً.', true); return null; }
    var hasDouble = !!pages.querySelector('.page.double');
    var pw = hasDouble ? '297mm' : '148.5mm', ph = '210mm';
    var frame = document.createElement('iframe');
    frame.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:-10000px;top:0;width:' + pw + ';height:' + ph + ';border:0;background:#fff';
    document.body.appendChild(frame);
    var doc = frame.contentDocument || frame.contentWindow.document;
    var css = (document.getElementById('mainStyles') || {}).textContent || '';
    var dyn = (document.getElementById('dynamicPageSize') || {}).textContent || '';
    var rootStyle = document.documentElement.style.cssText || '';
    doc.open();
    doc.write('<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="ckb-IQ" dir="rtl" style="' + rootStyle + '"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><title>نتائج الطلاب</title><style>' + css + '</style><style>' + dyn + ' @page{size:' + pw + ' ' + ph + ';margin:0}html,body{margin:0!important;padding:0!important;background:#fff!important;overflow:visible!important}.toolbar,.back-row,.slot-bar{display:none!important}#pagesScale{transform:none!important;width:auto!important;height:auto!important;overflow:visible!important}#pages{gap:0!important;margin:0!important;align-items:center!important}.page{box-shadow:none!important;margin:0!important;page-break-after:always!important}.page:last-child{page-break-after:auto!important}</style></head><body><div id="pagesScale"><div id="pages">' + pages.innerHTML + '</div></div></body></html>');
    doc.close();
    return {frame: frame, pw: pw, ph: ph};
  }
  function printCurrentCards(){
    var built = createCardsPrintFrame(); if(!built) return;
    setTimeout(function(){ try{ window.printIframeNow(built.frame); }catch(e){ pdfToast('تعذرت الطباعة. حاول مرة أخرى.', true); } }, 450);
    setTimeout(function(){ if(built.frame.parentNode) built.frame.remove(); }, 180000);
  }
  function examHostHtml(host){
    var css = (document.getElementById('mainStyles') || {}).textContent || '';
    var rootStyle = document.documentElement.style.cssText || '';
    return '<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="ckb-IQ" dir="rtl" class="exam-print-mode" style="' + rootStyle + '"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><title>بطاقات الامتحان</title><style>' + css + '</style><style>@page{size:A4 portrait;margin:12mm 10mm}html,body{margin:0!important;padding:0!important;background:#fff!important;overflow:visible!important}#examPrintHost{display:block!important}.exam-card-paper{page-break-after:always!important;break-after:page!important}.exam-card-paper:last-child{page-break-after:auto!important;break-after:auto!important}</style></head><body class="exam-print-mode">' + host.outerHTML + '</body></html>';
  }
  function createCurrentHostPrintFrame(host){
    if(!host) return null;
    var frame = document.createElement('iframe');
    frame.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:-10000px;top:0;width:210mm;height:297mm;border:0;background:#fff';
    document.body.appendChild(frame);
    var doc = frame.contentDocument || frame.contentWindow.document;
    doc.open(); doc.write(examHostHtml(host)); doc.close();
    return frame;
  }
  function printCurrentHost(host){
    var frame = createCurrentHostPrintFrame(host); if(!frame) return;
    setTimeout(function(){ try{ window.printIframeNow(frame); }catch(e){ pdfToast('تعذرت الطباعة. حاول مرة أخرى.', true); } }, 450);
    setTimeout(function(){ if(frame.parentNode) frame.remove(); }, 180000);
  }
  function captureCurrentHostAsPdf(host, filename, destination){
    var frame = createCurrentHostPrintFrame(host); if(!frame) return;
    setTimeout(function(){ capturePrintFrame(frame, filename || pdfSafeName('بطاقات-الطلاب'), destination).then(function(){ try{ frame.remove(); }catch(e){} }); }, 450);
    setTimeout(function(){ if(frame.parentNode) frame.remove(); }, 180000);
  }

  async function runPrintButtonAsPdf(printButton){
    if(!printButton || PDF_BUSY) return;
    var label = printButton.getAttribute('data-pdf-title') || printButton.textContent || 'طباعة';
    var onclick = printButton.getAttribute('onclick') || '';
    var filename = pdfSafeName(label), destination = await pdfPrepareDestination(filename);
    if(destination === false) return;
    if(/window\.print\s*\(/.test(onclick)){ downloadCurrentCardsPDF(destination); return; }
    if(/printAttendanceWarnings\s*\(/.test(onclick) && typeof window.exportAttendanceWarningsPdf === 'function'){ window.exportAttendanceWarningsPdf(); return; }
    requestPdfForPrintAction(function(){ printButton.click(); }, filename, destination);
  }
  async function downloadCurrentCardsPDF(destination){
    if(PDF_BUSY) return;
    var name = pdfSafeName('نتائج-الطلاب');
    if(destination === undefined || (destination && destination.type)){ destination = await pdfPrepareDestination(name); if(destination === false) return; }
    var built = createCardsPrintFrame(); if(!built) return;
    setTimeout(function(){ capturePrintFrame(built.frame, name, destination).then(function(){ try{ built.frame.remove(); }catch(e){} }); }, 450);
    setTimeout(function(){ if(built.frame.parentNode) built.frame.remove(); }, 180000);
  }

  function decoratePdfButtons(){
    var buttons = document.querySelectorAll('button');
    buttons.forEach(function(btn){
      if(btn.dataset.pdfPaired === '1' || btn.classList.contains('pdf-download-btn')) return;
      if(btn.disabled) return;
      var attr = btn.getAttribute('onclick') || '';
      // Only pair a PDF button with a button whose onclick actually triggers a real print
      // routine (every print trigger in this app is a call to a function literally named
      // print... or to window.print()). Matching on visible text/emoji alone previously
      // misfired on purely decorative uses of "طباعة"/🖨️ (e.g. a "كشوف النتائج" navigation
      // link whose icon is a printer but which does not print anything by itself), adding a
      // PDF button that did nothing useful wherever that icon appeared.
      if(!/\bprint[A-Za-z]*\s*\(/.test(attr)) return;
      if(!btn.parentNode) return;
      btn.dataset.pdfPaired = '1';
      var pdf = document.createElement('button');
      pdf.type = 'button';
      pdf.className = 'pdf-download-btn';
      pdf.title = 'تنزيل هذه الطباعة كملف PDF مباشر';
      pdf.setAttribute('aria-label', 'تنزيل هذه الطباعة كملف PDF');
      pdf.innerHTML = '📄 <span>PDF</span>';
      pdf.onclick = function(){ runPrintButtonAsPdf(btn); };
      btn.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', pdf);
    });
  }
  function installPdfStyles(){
    if(document.getElementById('daragatPdfStyles')) return;
    var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'daragatPdfStyles';
    st.textContent = '.pdf-download-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;min-height:34px;padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid #d4af37;border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff7d6,#d4af37);color:#4a2b00;font:800 12px Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.15);transition:transform .12s,filter .12s}.pdf-download-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.06)}.pdf-download-btn:active{transform:scale(.96)}.pdf-download-btn:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:wait}.pdf-download-btn span{font-size:11px}@media print{.pdf-download-btn{display:none!important}}@media(max-width:560px){.pdf-download-btn{padding-inline:8px;font-size:11px}.pdf-download-btn span{display:none}}';
    document.head.appendChild(st);
  }

  function installToolMenuStyles(){
    if(document.getElementById('daragatToolMenuStyles')) return;
    var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'daragatToolMenuStyles';
    st.textContent = '.txe-menu{position:relative;display:inline-block;margin:4px 0}'+
      '.txe-menu-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:38px;padding:9px 14px;border:1px solid #7a0e2e;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#9c1238,#7a0e2e);color:#fff;font:800 13.5px Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.15)}'+
      '.txe-menu-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)} .txe-menu-btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}'+
      '.txe-caret{font-size:11px;opacity:.85}'+
      '.txe-menu-panel{position:absolute;z-index:5000;top:calc(100% + 6px);right:0;min-width:220px;max-width:min(320px,90vw);background:#fff;border:1px solid #e0d8c8;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.22);padding:6px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}'+
      '.txe-menu-panel[hidden]{display:none}'+
      '.txe-menu-item{display:block;width:100%;text-align:right;padding:9px 12px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:#3a2a1a;font:700 13px Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}'+
      '.txe-menu-item:hover{background:#f5eee0}'+
      '.txe-menu-item-pdf{color:#7a5b00}'+
      '.txe-menu-item-ie{color:#1565c0}'+
      '.txe-menu-sep{height:1px;background:#eee;margin:3px 4px}'+
      '@media print{.txe-menu{display:none!important}}';
    document.head.appendChild(st);
  }
  // Groups every print / PDF-export / import-export button found anywhere inside a rendered
  // view into ONE "🖨️ طباعة وتصدير" button with a dropdown, instead of leaving them scattered
  // across the screen. This never changes what any button DOES — it only hides the original
  // buttons (kept fully intact in the DOM, data and all) and triggers their existing click
  // handler from the dropdown, so every safety check / confirmation dialog they already have
  // still runs exactly as before.
  function classifyToolButton(btn){
    if(btn.closest('.txe-menu')) return null;
    if(btn.closest('.nbxl')) return null; /* أزرار إكسل قسم الطلاب تبقى ظاهرة كما هي */
    if(btn.closest('.levels-record-title')) return null; /* سجل المستويات: لكل جدول (الأسبوعي والشهري) أزراره الخاصة */
    if(btn.disabled) return null;
    if(btn.classList.contains('pdf-download-btn')) return 'pdf';
    var attr = btn.getAttribute('onclick') || '';
    var text = (btn.textContent || '').trim();
    if(!text) return null;
    if(/\bprint[A-Za-z]*\s*\(|window\.print\s*\(/.test(attr)) return 'print';
    if(/\bexport[A-Za-z]*PDF\s*\(|downloadCurrentCardsPDF|downloadPdfFromPrintButton/.test(attr)) return 'pdf';
    if(/استيراد|تصدير/.test(text)) return 'ie';
    if(/\bimport[A-Za-z]*\(|\bbackupExport[A-Za-z]*\(|\bexport[A-Za-z]*Excel\s*\(|\brestore[A-Za-z]*\(/i.test(attr)) return 'ie';
    return null;
  }
  var TXE_ICON = {print: '🖨️', pdf: '📄', ie: '📑'};
  function closeAllToolMenus(except){
    document.querySelectorAll('.txe-menu-panel').forEach(function(p){ if(p !== except) p.hidden = true; });
  }
  function consolidateToolButtons(root){
    (root || document).querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(function(view){
      if(getComputedStyle(view).display === 'none') return;
      var candidates = [].slice.call(view.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(function(b){ return !b.closest('.txe-menu'); });
      var groups = [];
      candidates.forEach(function(b){
        if(b.dataset.txeGrouped === '1') return;
        var kind = classifyToolButton(b);
        if(kind) groups.push({btn: b, kind: kind});
      });
      if(groups.length < 2) return;
      var anchor = groups[0].btn;
      var menu = document.createElement('span');
      menu.className = 'txe-menu';
      var toggle = document.createElement('button');
      toggle.type = 'button';
      toggle.className = 'txe-menu-btn';
      toggle.innerHTML = '🖨️ طباعة وتصدير <span class="txe-caret">▾</span>';
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'txe-menu-panel';
      panel.hidden = true;
      groups.forEach(function(g, i){
        if(i > 0 && g.kind !== groups[i - 1].kind){
          var sep = document.createElement('div'); sep.className = 'txe-menu-sep'; panel.appendChild(sep);
        }
        var item = document.createElement('button');
        item.type = 'button';
        item.className = 'txe-menu-item txe-menu-item-' + g.kind;
        var label = (g.btn.textContent || '').trim().replace(/^[^\wأ-ي]+/u, '').trim();
        try{ var xl = g.btn.getAttribute('data-txe-label'), pv = g.btn.previousElementSibling; if(xl) label = xl; else if(g.btn.classList.contains('pdf-download-btn') && pv && pv.getAttribute('data-txe-label')) label = 'PDF — ' + pv.getAttribute('data-txe-label'); }catch(e){}
        item.textContent = (TXE_ICON[g.kind] || '') + ' ' + label;
        item.onclick = function(){ panel.hidden = true; g.btn.click(); };
        panel.appendChild(item);
        g.btn.dataset.txeGrouped = '1';
        g.btn.style.display = 'none';
      });
      toggle.onclick = function(e){
        e.stopPropagation();
        var willOpen = panel.hidden;
        closeAllToolMenus();
        panel.hidden = !willOpen;
      };
      menu.appendChild(toggle);
      menu.appendChild(panel);
      anchor.insertAdjacentElement('beforebegin', menu);
    });
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', function(){ closeAllToolMenus(); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key === 'Escape') closeAllToolMenus(); });

  function installPdfFeature(){
    installPdfStyles();
    if(window.__daragatPdfFeatureInstalled) return;
    window.__daragatPdfFeatureInstalled = true;
    window.downloadCurrentCardsPDF = downloadCurrentCardsPDF;
    window.printCurrentCards = printCurrentCards;
    window.downloadPdfFromPrintFrame = downloadPdfFromPrintFrame;
    window.downloadPdfFromPrintButton = runPrintButtonAsPdf;
    window.exportResultsPDF = downloadCurrentCardsPDF;
    window.exportExamPDF = async function(){
      var name = pdfSafeName('بطاقة-الامتحان'), destination = await pdfPrepareDestination(name);
      if(destination === false) return;
      requestPdfForPrintAction(function(){ printExamSelection(false); }, name, destination);
    };
    var originalBatchPrint = window.printGradebookSectionCards;
    if(typeof originalBatchPrint === 'function'){
      window.printGradebookSectionCards = function(meta){
        var oldPrint = window.print, restored = false;
        function restore(){ if(!restored){ restored = true; window.print = oldPrint; } }
        window.print = function(){
          restore();
          setTimeout(function(){
            var host = document.getElementById('examPrintHost');
            if(!host){ pdfToast('تعذر العثور على صفحة البطاقات.', true); return; }
            if(PDF_REQUEST){ var req = PDF_REQUEST; PDF_REQUEST = null; captureCurrentHostAsPdf(host, req.filename, req.destination); }
            else printCurrentHost(host);
            // the temporary print host is not needed on screen any more
            try{ document.body.classList.remove('exam-print-mode'); if(host.parentNode) host.remove(); }catch(e){}
          }, 80);
        };
        try{ originalBatchPrint(meta); }catch(e){ restore(); throw e; }
        setTimeout(restore, 5000);
      };
    }
    var originalPrint = window.printIframeNow;
    window.printIframeNow = function(frame){
      if(!frame) return;
      if(PDF_REQUEST){
        var req = PDF_REQUEST; PDF_REQUEST = null;
        try{ if(typeof applyDigitsToPrintDoc === 'function') applyDigitsToPrintDoc(frame.contentDocument); }catch(e){}
        capturePrintFrame(frame, req.filename, req.destination);
        return;
      }
      try{
        if(frame.style){
          // Keep the print document in the DOM without making it transparent or placing it
          // behind the page; Android/WebView can ignore printing for hidden/transparent frames.
          frame.style.left = '-10000px'; frame.style.top = '0'; frame.style.right = 'auto'; frame.style.bottom = 'auto';
          frame.style.opacity = '1'; frame.style.zIndex = '2147483000'; frame.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
        }
        try{ if(typeof applyDigitsToPrintDoc === 'function') applyDigitsToPrintDoc(frame.contentDocument); }catch(e){}
        setTimeout(function(){
          smartPrintFrame(frame).catch(function(err){
            console.warn('print failed', err);
            try{ if(typeof originalPrint === 'function') originalPrint(frame); }catch(ignore){}
          });
        }, 120);
      }catch(e){ try{ if(typeof originalPrint === 'function') return originalPrint(frame); }catch(ignore){} }
    };
    decoratePdfButtons();
    installToolMenuStyles();
    consolidateToolButtons();
    var observer = new MutationObserver(function(){
      if(PDF_DECORATE_TIMER) return;
      PDF_DECORATE_TIMER = setTimeout(function(){ PDF_DECORATE_TIMER = null; decoratePdfButtons(); consolidateToolButtons(); }, 80);
    });
    if(document.body) observer.observe(document.body, {childList: true, subtree: true});
    setTimeout(function(){ decoratePdfButtons(); consolidateToolButtons(); }, 500);
    setTimeout(function(){ decoratePdfButtons(); consolidateToolButtons(); }, 1500);
  }

  if(document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', installPdfFeature);
  else installPdfFeature();
})();

/* سجل إنذارات الغياب — مستقل عن سجلات الغياب الأصلية */
var ATTENDANCE_WARNINGS_KEY='school_attendance_warnings_v1';
function attendanceWarningsConfig(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(ATTENDANCE_WARNINGS_KEY)||'{}')}catch(e){return {}}}
function saveAttendanceWarningsConfig(c){try{localStorage.setItem(ATTENDANCE_WARNINGS_KEY,JSON.stringify(c))}catch(e){}}
function openAttendanceWarnings(){renderAttendanceWarnings();navigateTo('view-attendance',{page:'warnings'});}
function attendanceWarningsSections(g){return gbSectionsForGrade(g)||[]}
function attendanceWarningsSectionChanged(){var g=(document.getElementById('awGrade')||{}).value||'',sel=document.getElementById('awSection');if(sel)sel.innerHTML='<option value="">اختر الشعبة</option>'+attendanceWarningsSections(g).map(function(x){return '<option value="'+escapeHtml(x.id)+'">'+escapeHtml(x.label)+'</option>'}).join('')}
function attendanceWarningDayCount(g,sid,stId){var set={};(ATTENDANCE_STATE.records||[]).forEach(function(r){if(r.grade===g&&r.sectionId===sid&&r.studentId===stId&&(r.status==='غائب'||r.status==='غائب بعذر'))set[r.date]=1});return Object.keys(set).length}
function attendanceWarningMark(n,c){if(n>=Number(c.third||10))return ['—','—','الإنذار الثالث'];if(n>=Number(c.second||5))return ['—','الإنذار الثاني','—'];if(n>=Number(c.first||3))return ['الإنذار الأول','—','—'];return ['—','—','—']}
function loadAttendanceWarnings(){var g=(document.getElementById('awGrade')||{}).value||'',sid=(document.getElementById('awSection')||{}).value||'',sec=attendanceWarningsSections(g).find(function(x){return x.id===sid}),out=document.getElementById('attendanceWarningsOutput'),c=attendanceWarningsConfig();if(!out||!sec){if(out)out.innerHTML='<div class="empty-module">اختر الصف والشعبة لعرض الإنذارات.</div>';return}var rows='';(sec.students||[]).filter(function(st){return String(st.name||'').trim()}).forEach(function(st,i){var n=attendanceWarningDayCount(g,sid,st.id),m=attendanceWarningMark(n,c);rows+='<tr><td>'+toArabicDigits(String(i+1))+'</td><td class="name">'+escapeHtml(st.name)+'</td><td>'+escapeHtml(g)+' / '+escapeHtml(sec.label)+'</td><td>'+escapeHtml(m[0])+'</td><td>'+escapeHtml(m[1])+'</td><td>'+escapeHtml(m[2])+'</td></tr>'});out.innerHTML='<div class="surface-bar"><strong>إنذارات الغياب — '+escapeHtml(g)+' / '+escapeHtml(sec.label)+'</strong><span>إجمالي أيام الغياب يحتسب من سجل الغياب المحفوظ.</span></div><div class="table-scroll"><table class="attendance-warnings-table" id="attendanceWarningsTable"><thead><tr><th>ت</th><th>اسم الطالب</th><th>الصف والشعبة</th><th>الإنذار الأول</th><th>الإنذار الثاني</th><th>الإنذار الثالث</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+(rows||'<tr><td colspan="6">لا يوجد طلاب.</td></tr>')+'</tbody></table></div>'}

g=(document.getElementById('awGrade')||{}).value||'',sid=(document.getElementById('awSection')||{}).value||'',sec=attendanceWarningsSections(g).find(function(x){return x.id===sid}),c=attendanceWarningsConfig();return '<!doctype html><html lang="ckb-IQ" dir="rtl"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>إنذارات الغياب</title><style>@page{size:A4 function printAttendanceWarnings(){var html=attendanceWarningsPrintHtml();if(!html){alert('اعرض الإنذارات أولاً.');return}var f=document.createElement('iframe');f.style.cssText='position:fixed;left:-10000px;top:0;width:210mm;height:297mm;border:0';document.body.appendChild(f);var d=f.contentDocument||f.contentWindow.document;d.open();d.write(html);d.close();setTimeout(function(){try{window.printIframeNow(f);}catch(e){alert('تعذرت الطباعة.');}},450);setTimeout(function(){if(f.parentNode)f.remove();},180000)}
function exportAttendanceWarningsPdf(){var html=attendanceWarningsPrintHtml();if(!html){alert('اعرض الإنذارات أولاً.');return}var f=document.createElement('iframe');f.style.cssText='position:fixed;left:-10000px;top:0;width:210mm;height:297mm;border:0';document.body.appendChild(f);var d=f.contentDocument||f.contentWindow.document;d.open();d.write(html);d.close();setTimeout(function(){if(typeof downloadPdfFromPrintFrame==='function')downloadPdfFromPrintFrame(f,'إنذارات-الغياب.pdf',null).then(function(){setTimeout(function(){if(f.parentNode)f.remove()},500)});else alert('ميزة PDF غير جاهزة.');},400)}
function renderAttendanceWarnings(){var el=document.getElementById('view-attendance'),c=attendanceWarningsConfig();el.innerHTML='<div class="module-shell attendance-warnings-shell"><div class="module-head"><div class="module-title"><span class="mi">⚠️</span><div><h2>الإنذارات</h2><p>إصدار إنذارات الغياب حسب عدد الأيام المحفوظة في سجل الغياب.</p></div></div><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap"><button class="material-btn secondary" onclick="appGoBack()">رجوع إلى الغياب</button><button class="material-btn" onclick="printAttendanceWarnings()">🖨️ طباعة</button><button class="material-btn accent" onclick="exportAttendanceWarningsPdf()">📄 تصدير PDF</button></div></div><div class="attendance-warnings-controls"><div class="mat-field"><label>الصف</label><select id="awGrade" onchange="attendanceWarningsSectionChanged()"><option value="">اختر الصف</option>'+gradebookGradeLabels().map(function(g){return '<option value="'+escapeHtml(g)+'">'+escapeHtml(g)+'</option>'}).join('')+'</select></div><div class="mat-field"><label>الشعبة</label><select id="awSection"><option value="">اختر الشعبة</option></select></div><div class="mat-field"><label>أيام الإنذار الأول</label><input id="awFirst" type="number" min="1" value="'+escapeHtml(String(c.first||3))+'" onchange="saveAttendanceWarningThresholds()"></div><div class="mat-field"><label>أيام الإنذار الثاني</label><input id="awSecond" type="number" min="1" value="'+escapeHtml(String(c.second||5))+'" onchange="saveAttendanceWarningThresholds()"></div><div class="mat-field"><label>أيام الإنذار الثالث</label><input id="awThird" type="number" min="1" value="'+escapeHtml(String(c.third||10))+'" onchange="saveAttendanceWarningThresholds()"></div><button class="material-btn" onclick="loadAttendanceWarnings()">عرض الإنذارات</button></div><div id="attendanceWarningsOutput" class="attendance-table-wrap"><div class="empty-module">اختر الصف والشعبة.</div></div></div>'}
function saveAttendanceWarningThresholds(){var c={first:Number((document.getElementById('awFirst')||{}).value||3),second:Number((document.getElementById('awSecond')||{}).value||5),third:Number((document.getElementById('awThird')||{}).value||10)};saveAttendanceWarningsConfig(c);if(document.getElementById('attendanceWarningsOutput')&&document.getElementById('awSection').value)loadAttendanceWarnings()}
/* تحديث واجهة الإنذارات: جدول موحد لجميع الصفوف والشعب */
function renderAttendanceWarnings(){var el=document.getElementById('view-attendance'),c=attendanceWarningsConfig();el.innerHTML='<div class="module-shell attendance-warnings-shell"><div class="module-head"><div class="module-title"><span class="mi">⚠️</span><div><h2>الإنذارات</h2><p>عرض جميع الطلاب الذين بلغ غيابهم حد أحد الإنذارات.</p></div></div><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap"><button class="material-btn secondary" onclick="appGoBack()">رجوع إلى الغياب</button><button class="material-btn" onclick="openAttendanceWarningSettings()">⚙️ ضبط إنذار الغياب</button><button class="material-btn" onclick="printAttendanceWarnings()">🖨️ طباعة</button><button class="material-btn accent" onclick="exportAttendanceWarningsPdf()">📄 تصدير PDF</button></div></div><div id="attendanceWarningsOutput" class="attendance-table-wrap"><div class="empty-module">اضغط على «عرض الإنذارات» لعرض الطلاب المستحقين.</div></div><div style="margin-top:12px"><button class="material-btn" onclick="loadAttendanceWarnings()">عرض / تحديث جدول الإنذارات</button></div></div>'}
function loadAttendanceWarnings(){var out=document.getElementById('attendanceWarningsOutput'),c=attendanceWarningsConfig(),rows='',count=0;gradebookGradeLabels().forEach(function(g){gbSectionsForGrade(g).forEach(function(sec){(sec.students||[]).filter(function(st){return String(st.name||'').trim()}).forEach(function(st){var n=attendanceWarningDayCount(g,sec.id,st.id);if(n>=Number(c.first||3)){var m=attendanceWarningMark(n,c);count++;rows+='<tr><td>'+toArabicDigits(String(count))+'</td><td class="name">'+escapeHtml(st.name)+'</td><td>'+escapeHtml(g)+'</td><td>'+escapeHtml(sec.label)+'</td><td>'+escapeHtml(m[0])+'</td><td>'+escapeHtml(m[1])+'</td><td>'+escapeHtml(m[2])+'</td></tr>'}})})});out.innerHTML='<div class="surface-bar"><strong>جدول إنذارات الغياب</strong><span>'+toArabicDigits(String(count))+' طالب مستحق — الأول: '+toArabicDigits(String(c.first||3))+'، الثاني: '+toArabicDigits(String(c.second||5))+'، الثالث: '+toArabicDigits(String(c.third||10))+' أيام</span></div><div class="table-scroll"><table class="attendance-warnings-table" id="attendanceWarningsTable"><thead><tr><th>ت</th><th>اسم الطالب</th><th>الصف</th><th>الشعبة</th><th>الإنذار الأول</th><th>الإنذار الثاني</th><th>الإنذار الثالث</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+(rows||'<tr><td colspan="7">لا يوجد طلاب بلغوا حد الإنذار.</td></tr>')+'</tbody></table></div>'}
function openAttendanceWarningSettings(){var c=attendanceWarningsConfig(),old=document.getElementById('attendanceWarningSettings');if(old)old.remove();var d=document.createElement('div');d.id='attendanceWarningSettings';d.className='aw-settings-overlay';d.innerHTML='<div class="aw-settings-card"><div class="aw-settings-head"><div><h3>ضبط إنذار الغياب</h3><p>حدد عدد أيام الغياب لكل مستوى إنذار.</p></div><button onclick="document.getElementById(\'attendanceWarningSettings\').remove()">✕</button></div><div class="aw-settings-grid"><label>أيام الإنذار الأول<input id="awSetFirst" type="number" min="1" value="'+escapeHtml(String(c.first||3))+'"></label><label>أيام الإنذار الثاني<input id="awSetSecond" type="number" min="1" value="'+escapeHtml(String(c.second||5))+'"></label><label>أيام الإنذار الثالث<input id="awSetThird" type="number" min="1" value="'+escapeHtml(String(c.third||10))+'"></label></div><div class="aw-settings-actions"><button class="material-btn secondary" onclick="document.getElementById(\'attendanceWarningSettings\').remove()">إلغاء</button><button class="material-btn" onclick="saveAttendanceWarningSettings()">حفظ الإعدادات</button></div></div>';document.body.appendChild(d)}
function saveAttendanceWarningSettings(){var c={first:Number(document.getElementById('awSetFirst').value||3),second:Number(document.getElementById('awSetSecond').value||5),third:Number(document.getElementById('awSetThird').value||10)};if(c.second<c.first)c.second=c.first;if(c.third<c.second)c.third=c.second;saveAttendanceWarningsConfig(c);var d=document.getElementById('attendanceWarningSettings');if(d)d.remove();loadAttendanceWarnings()}

function ensureProfessionalGrades(){if(!Array.isArray(APP.professionalGrades))APP.professionalGrades=[];if(currentStage()==='professional')APP.professionalGrades.forEach(function(label){var g=APP.grades.find(function(x){return x.label===label});if(!g){g={id:'g_'+gradeKey(label),label:label,sections:[]};APP.grades.push(g);}if(!Array.isArray(g.sections))g.sections=[];});}
function addProfessionalGrade(){var input=document.getElementById('proNewGrade'),label=input&&input.value.trim();if(!label)return;ensureProfessionalGrades();if(APP.professionalGrades.indexOf(label)!==-1){alert('هذا الصف موجود مسبقًا.');return;}APP.professionalGrades.push(label);var g={id:'g_'+gradeKey(label),label:label,sections:[]};APP.grades.push(g);saveApp();if(input)input.value='';renderProfessionalGradesView(false);}
function removeProfessionalGrade(label){if(!confirm('حذف الصف وكل شعبه وطلابه؟'))return;APP.professionalGrades=(APP.professionalGrades||[]).filter(function(x){return x!==label});APP.grades=(APP.grades||[]).filter(function(x){return x.label!==label});saveApp();renderProfessionalGradesView(false);}
function addProfessionalSection(label){var input=document.getElementById('proSec_'+gradeKey(label)),v=input&&input.value.trim();if(!v)return;var g=APP.grades.find(function(x){return x.label===label});if(!g){ensureProfessionalGrades();g=APP.grades.find(function(x){return x.label===label});}if((g.sections||[]).some(function(x){return x.label===v})){alert('هذه الشعبة موجودة.');return;}g.sections.push({id:'s_'+gradeKey(label)+'_'+Date.now(),label:v,guide:'',students:[]});saveApp();renderProfessionalGradesView(false);}
function removeProfessionalSection(label,sid){var g=APP.grades.find(function(x){return x.label===label});if(!g)return;if(!confirm('حذف الشعبة وطلابها؟'))return;g.sections=g.sections.filter(function(x){return x.id!==sid});saveApp();renderProfessionalGradesView(false);}
function renderProfessionalGradesView(isOnboarding){ensureProfessionalGrades();var el=document.getElementById('view-grades');el.className='view wide';var rows=(APP.professionalGrades||[]).map(function(label){var g=APP.grades.find(function(x){return x.label===label})||{sections:[]};var chips=(g.sections||[]).map(function(sec){return '<span class="pro-section-chip">'+escapeHtml(sec.label)+' <button onclick="removeProfessionalSection('+JSON.stringify(label)+','+JSON.stringify(sec.id)+')">×</button></span>'}).join('');return '<article class="pro-grade-card"><div class="pro-grade-head"><strong>'+escapeHtml(label)+'</strong><button class="material-btn danger" onclick="removeProfessionalGrade('+JSON.stringify(label)+')">حذف الصف</button></div><div class="pro-section-list">'+(chips||'<small>لا توجد شعب بعد.</small>')+'</div><div class="pro-add-section"><input id="proSec_'+gradeKey(label)+'" placeholder="اكتب اسم الشعبة"><button class="material-btn" onclick="addProfessionalSection('+JSON.stringify(label)+')">＋ إضافة شعبة</button></div></article>'}).join('');el.innerHTML='<div class="module-shell"><div class="module-head"><div class="module-title"><span class="mi">🏫</span><div><h2>الصفوف والشعب المهنية</h2><p>أضف أي عدد من الصفوف، ولكل صف أي عدد من الشعب.</p></div></div><button class="material-btn secondary" onclick="appGoBack()">رجوع</button></div><div class="pro-add-grade"><input id="proNewGrade" placeholder="اكتب اسم الصف المهني"><button class="material-btn" onclick="addProfessionalGrade()">＋ إضافة صف</button></div><div class="pro-grade-list">'+(rows||'<div class="empty-module">لم تتم إضافة صفوف مهنية بعد.</div>')+'</div></div>'}

/* بنية المرحلة المهنية: أقسام ← ثلاث مراحل ← شعب غير محدودة */
function ensureProfessionalGrades(){
  if(!Array.isArray(APP.grades))APP.grades=[];
  if(!Array.isArray(APP.professionalDepartments))APP.professionalDepartments=[{name:'كهرباء',stages:[{name:'الأول',sections:['أ','ب']},{name:'الثاني',sections:['أ','ب']},{name:'الثالث',sections:['أ','ب']}]}];
  if(!APP.professionalDepartments.length)APP.professionalDepartments=[{name:'كهرباء',stages:[{name:'الأول',sections:['أ','ب']},{name:'الثاني',sections:['أ','ب']},{name:'الثالث',sections:['أ','ب']}]}];
  APP.professionalDepartments.forEach(function(d){if(!Array.isArray(d.stages))d.stages=[];while(d.stages.length<3)d.stages.push({name:['الأول','الثاني','الثالث'][d.stages.length],sections:[]});d.stages=d.stages.slice(0,3);d.stages.forEach(function(st){if(!Array.isArray(st.sections))st.sections=[];});});
  APP.professionalDepartments.forEach(function(d){d.stages.forEach(function(st){var label=d.name+' — '+st.name,g=APP.grades.find(function(x){return x.label===label});if(!g){g={id:'g_'+gradeKey(label),label:label,sections:[]};APP.grades.push(g);}g.sections=st.sections.map(function(sec){var old=(g.sections||[]).find(function(x){return x.label===sec})||{id:'s_'+gradeKey(label)+'_'+gradeKey(sec),label:sec,guide:'',students:[]};if(!Array.isArray(old.students))old.students=[];while(old.students.length<5){var ix=old.students.length;old.students.push({id:'st_pro_'+gradeKey(label)+'_'+gradeKey(sec)+'_'+ix,name:DEMO_STUDENT_NAMES[(ix+demoGradeIndex(label))%DEMO_STUDENT_NAMES.length],demoDefault:true});}return old;});});});
}
function saveProfessionalStructure(){ensureProfessionalGrades();saveApp();}
function addProfessionalDepartment(){var el=document.getElementById('proNewDepartment'),name=el&&el.value.trim();if(!name)return;ensureProfessionalGrades();if(APP.professionalDepartments.some(function(d){return d.name===name})){alert('القسم موجود مسبقًا.');return;}APP.professionalDepartments.push({name:name,stages:[{name:'الأول',sections:[]},{name:'الثاني',sections:[]},{name:'الثالث',sections:[]}]});saveProfessionalStructure();renderProfessionalGradesView(false);}
function addProfessionalDepartmentSection(di,si){var inp=document.getElementById('proDeptSec_'+di+'_'+si),v=inp&&inp.value.trim();if(!v)return;var st=APP.professionalDepartments[di].stages[si];if(st.sections.indexOf(v)>=0){alert('هذه الشعبة موجودة.');return;}st.sections.push(v);saveProfessionalStructure();renderProfessionalGradesView(false);}
function removeProfessionalDepartmentSection(di,si,sec){var st=APP.professionalDepartments[di].stages[si];if(!confirm('حذف هذه الشعبة وبيانات طلابها؟'))return;st.sections=st.sections.filter(function(x){return x!==sec});saveProfessionalStructure();renderProfessionalGradesView(false);}
function removeProfessionalDepartment(di){if(!confirm('حذف القسم ومراحله وشعبه وبيانات طلابه؟'))return;var d=APP.professionalDepartments[di];d.stages.forEach(function(st){APP.grades=APP.grades.filter(function(g){return g.label!==d.name+' — '+st.name})});APP.professionalDepartments.splice(di,1);saveApp();renderProfessionalGradesView(false);}
function professionalFlatLabels(){ensureProfessionalGrades();var a=[];APP.professionalDepartments.forEach(function(d){d.stages.forEach(function(st){a.push(d.name+' — '+st.name)})});return a}
function gradebookGradeLabels(){var stage=currentStage();if(stage==='professional'){return professionalFlatLabels();}if(stage==='intermediate')return ['الأول متوسط','الثاني متوسط','الثالث متوسط'];if(stage==='prep')return ['الرابع العلمي','الخامس العلمي','السادس العلمي','الرابع الأدبي','الخامس الأدبي','السادس الأدبي'];if(stage==='secondary'){ensureSecondaryDefaultGrades();return ['الأول','الثاني','الثالث','الرابع علمي','الرابع أدبي','الخامس علمي','الخامس أدبي','السادس علمي','السادس أدبي'];}if(stage==='basic')return ['الأول أساسي - ابتدائي','الثاني أساسي - ابتدائي','الثالث أساسي - ابتدائي','الرابع أساسي - ابتدائي','الخامس أساسي - ابتدائي','السادس أساسي - ابتدائي','الأول أساسي - متوسط','الثاني أساسي - متوسط','الثالث أساسي - متوسط'];return PRIMARY_GRADES.slice();}
function visibleGradeGroups(){if(currentStage()==='professional'){return [{stage:'professional',title:'الأقسام المهنية',labels:professionalFlatLabels()}];}if(!currentStage())return GRADE_GROUPS.slice();return GRADE_GROUPS.filter(function(g){return g.stage===currentStage()});}
function openProfessionalStudents(gradeLabel, sectionId, sectionLabel){
  ensureProfessionalGrades();
  var g=APP.grades.find(function(x){return x.label===gradeLabel;});
  var sec=g&&Array.isArray(g.sections)?g.sections.find(function(x){return String(x.id)===String(sectionId)||x.label===sectionLabel;}):null;
  if(!sec){alert('تعذر العثور على بيانات الشعبة. أعد فتح قسم الطلاب ثم حاول مرة أخرى.');return;}
  openStudents(gradeLabel,sec.id);
}
function toggleProfessionalConfig(){
  var el=document.getElementById('professionalConfigPanel'),ar=document.getElementById('professionalConfigArrow');
  if(!el)return; var hidden=el.style.display==='none';el.style.display=hidden?'block':'none';if(ar)ar.textContent=hidden?'⌃':'⌄';
}
function renderProfessionalGradesView(){
  ensureProfessionalGrades();
  var el=document.getElementById('view-grades');
  var cards=(APP.professionalDepartments||[]).map(function(d,di){
    var stages=(d.stages||[]).map(function(st,si){
      var label=d.name+' — '+st.name,g=APP.grades.find(function(x){return x.label===label}),chips=(st.sections||[]).map(function(sec){var gs=g&&g.sections?g.sections.find(function(x){return x.label===sec}):null;return '<span class="pro-section-chip" title="فتح طلاب الشعبة" onclick="openProfessionalStudents('+escapeHtml(JSON.stringify(label))+','+escapeHtml(JSON.stringify(gs?gs.id:''))+','+escapeHtml(JSON.stringify(sec))+')">📚 '+escapeHtml(sec)+' <button type="button" onclick="event.stopPropagation();removeProfessionalDepartmentSection('+di+','+si+','+JSON.stringify(sec)+')">×</button></span>';}).join('');
      return '<div class="pro-stage-card"><strong>'+escapeHtml(st.name)+'</strong><div class="pro-section-list">'+(chips||'<small>لا توجد شعب بعد.</small>')+'</div><div class="pro-add-section"><input id="proDeptSec_'+di+'_'+si+'" placeholder="اسم الشعبة"><button class="material-btn" onclick="addProfessionalDepartmentSection('+di+','+si+')">＋ إضافة شعبة</button></div></div>';
    }).join('');
    return '<article class="pro-grade-card"><div class="pro-grade-head"><strong>'+escapeHtml(d.name)+'</strong><button class="material-btn danger" onclick="removeProfessionalDepartment('+di+')">حذف القسم</button></div>'+stages+'</article>';
  }).join('');
  var studentCards='';
  (APP.professionalDepartments||[]).forEach(function(d){(d.stages||[]).forEach(function(st){var label=d.name+' — '+st.name,g=APP.grades.find(function(x){return x.label===label});studentCards+='<section class="managed-stage-block"><h3>📘 '+escapeHtml(d.name)+' — '+escapeHtml(st.name)+'</h3><div class="grade-select-grid managed-sections-grid">'+((g&&g.sections||[]).map(function(sec){return '<button type="button" class="grade-select-card managed-section-card" onclick="openProfessionalStudents('+escapeHtml(JSON.stringify(label))+','+escapeHtml(JSON.stringify(sec.id))+','+escapeHtml(JSON.stringify(sec.label))+')"><strong>📚 شعبة '+escapeHtml(sec.label)+'</strong><small>'+String((sec.students||[]).length)+' طالب — عرض وتعديل البيانات</small></button>';}).join('')||'<div class="empty-hint">لا توجد شعب في هذه المرحلة.</div>')+'</div></section>';});});
  el.className='view wide';
  el.innerHTML='<div class="module-shell"><div class="module-head"><div class="module-title"><span class="mi">🏫</span><div><h2>الأقسام والمراحل المهنية</h2><p>اختر أيقونة المرحلة ثم الشعبة لعرض معلومات الطلاب أو إضافة طالب.</p></div></div><button class="material-btn secondary" onclick="appGoBack()">رجوع</button></div><button type="button" class="grades-config-toggle" onclick="toggleProfessionalConfig()"><span>⚙️</span><div><strong>إعداد الأقسام والمراحل والشعب</strong><small>اضغط لإظهار خيارات الإضافة والحذف</small></div><b id="professionalConfigArrow">⌄</b></button><div id="professionalConfigPanel" class="panel wide management-config-panel" style="display:none"><div class="pro-add-grade"><input id="proNewDepartment" placeholder="اكتب اسم القسم المهني"><button class="material-btn" onclick="addProfessionalDepartment()">＋ إضافة قسم</button></div><div class="pro-grade-list">'+(cards||'<div class="empty-module">لا توجد أقسام.</div>')+'</div></div><div class="managed-sections-head"><h3>📋 فتح بيانات الطلاب</h3><p>اضغط على المرحلة والشعبة كما في المرحلة الثانوية.</p></div>'+studentCards+'</div>';
}
/* إصلاح موثوق لزر الإعدادات */
window.openSettings=function(){try{renderSettingsView(false);navigateTo('view-settings');}catch(e){var v=document.getElementById('view-settings');if(v){v.style.display='block';v.innerHTML='<div class="module-shell"><h2>الإعدادات</h2><p>تعذر تحميل الإعدادات: '+escapeHtml(e.message||'')+'</p></div>';}}};
</script>
<script id="dls-local-sync">
/* ---- DLS core: pure diff / apply helpers (no DOM, no globals) ---- */
var DLSCore = (function(){
  'use strict';
  function isObj(x){ return x !== null && typeof x === 'object' && !Array.isArray(x); }
  function bad(k){ return k === '__proto__' || k === 'constructor' || k === 'prototype'; }
  function canon(v){
    if(v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return JSON.stringify(v);
    if(Array.isArray(v)){ var o = '['; for(var i = 0; i < v.length; i++){ if(i) o += ','; o += canon(v[i]); } return o + ']'; }
    var ks = Object.keys(v).sort(), r = '{';
    for(var j = 0; j < ks.length; j++){ if(j) r += ','; r += JSON.stringify(ks[j]) + ':' + canon(v[ks[j]]); }
    return r + '}';
  }
  function fnv(s){ var h = 0x811c9dc5; for(var i = 0; i < s.length; i++){ h ^= s.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193) >>> 0; } return h.toString(36); }
  function hashOf(v){ return fnv(canon(v)); }
  // element key inside a keyed array. id mode: "s:<id>" / "n:<id>", hash mode: "#<fnv>:<len>"
  function keyOf(x, mode){
    if(mode === 'id'){ var id = x.id; return (typeof id === 'number' ? 'n:' : 's:') + id; }
    var c = canon(x); return '#' + fnv(c) + ':' + c.length;
  }
  function arrMode(arr){
    if(!arr.length) return 'empty';
    var i, x, ids = {}, idOk = true;
    for(i = 0; i < arr.length; i++){
      x = arr[i];
      if(!isObj(x)) return 'atomic';
      var id = x.id;
      if(typeof id === 'string' || typeof id === 'number'){
        var k = (typeof id === 'number' ? 'n:' : 's:') + id;
        if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ids, k)) idOk = false; ids[k] = 1;
      } else idOk = false;
    }
    if(idOk) return 'id';
    var seen = {};
    for(i = 0; i < arr.length; i++){
      var h = keyOf(arr[i], 'hash');
      if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(seen, h)) return 'atomic';
      seen[h] = 1;
    }
    return 'hash';
  }
  function modeOf(a, b){
    var ma = arrMode(a), mb = arrMode(b);
    if(ma === 'atomic' || mb === 'atomic') return 'atomic';
    if(ma === 'empty') return mb;
    if(mb === 'empty') return ma;
    return ma === mb ? ma : 'atomic';
  }
  function diffArr(a, b, path, ops){
    var mode = modeOf(a, b);
    if(mode === 'atomic'){ if(canon(a) !== canon(b)) ops.push({p: path, o: 's', v: b}); return; }
    if(mode === 'empty') return;
    var ka = a.map(function(x){ return keyOf(x, mode); }), kb = b.map(function(x){ return keyOf(x, mode); });
    var ma = {}, mb = {}, i;
    for(i = 0; i < a.length; i++) ma[ka[i]] = a[i];
    for(i = 0; i < b.length; i++) mb[kb[i]] = b[i];
    for(i = 0; i < b.length; i++) if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ma, kb[i])) ops.push({p: path.concat([{a: kb[i]}]), o: 's', v: b[i]});
    for(i = 0; i < a.length; i++) if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(mb, ka[i])) ops.push({p: path.concat([{a: ka[i]}]), o: 'd'});
    if(mode === 'id') for(i = 0; i < b.length; i++){ if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ma, kb[i])) diffVal(ma[kb[i]], b[i], path.concat([{a: kb[i]}]), ops); }
    var expected = ka.filter(function(k){ return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(mb, k); })
      .concat(kb.filter(function(k){ return !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ma, k); }));
    if(expected.join('\u0001') !== kb.join('\u0001')) ops.push({p: path, o: 'r', ids: kb});
  }
  function diffVal(a, b, path, ops){
    if(a === b) return;
    var aa = Array.isArray(a), ab = Array.isArray(b);
    if(aa && ab) return diffArr(a, b, path, ops);
    if(isObj(a) && isObj(b)){
      var k;
      for(k in a) if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(a, k) && !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(b, k)) ops.push({p: path.concat([k]), o: 'd'});
      for(k in b){
        if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(b, k)) continue;
        if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(a, k)) ops.push({p: path.concat([k]), o: 's', v: b[k]});
        else diffVal(a[k], b[k], path.concat([k]), ops);
      }
      return;
    }
    ops.push({p: path, o: 's', v: b});
  }
  function diff(a, b){ var ops = []; diffVal(a, b, [], ops); return ops; }

  function findIdx(arr, key){
    var hash = key.charAt(0) === '#';
    for(var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++){
      var x = arr[i];
      if(!isObj(x)) continue;
      if(hash){ if(keyOf(x, 'hash') === key) return i; }
      else if(x.id !== undefined && ((typeof x.id === 'number' ? 'n:' : 's:') + x.id) === key) return i;
    }
    return -1;
  }
  function child(cur, seg){
    if(typeof seg === 'string'){
      if(!isObj(cur) || bad(seg) || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cur, seg)) return undefined;
      return cur[seg];
    }
    if(!Array.isArray(cur)) return undefined;
    var i = findIdx(cur, seg.a);
    return i < 0 ? undefined : cur[i];
  }
  function reorder(arr, ids){
    if(!Array.isArray(arr)) return;
    var hash = ids.length && ids[0].charAt(0) === '#', map = {}, i, out = [];

  var peers = {}, pending = {}, pollT = null, hbT = null, polling = false, seen = {}, lastErr = '', online = null;
